en.name: Zhong Li
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player (different from the previous night): they're safe from Demon. You are an Archon.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player (different from the previous night): they're safe from Demon. You are an Archon.

en.flavor: Even though I do not seek the throne, I am not ignorant of the hardships faced by the people.
en.otherNightReminder: Wake the Zhong Li up. They point at any dead player.(If yesterday's target was chosen, remind him to change the target). Place Zhongli's "Protect" rtokennext to his chosen player character's token, then put Zhong Li back to sleep.
